requirements: R1: Implement pixel-perfect design refresh in frontend Svelte views matching the approved mockup design/approved/20261117071024-mockup/mockup.html including layout hierarchy, typography, colors, and responsive breakpoints
R2: Preserve all existing knowledge base search, filter, and document exploration interactions while ensuring WCAG AAA accessibility and mobile responsiveness across viewport sizes down to 375px

slices.title: Implement pixel-perfect UI refresh from approved mockup
slices.jtbd: When implementing frontend styles and layout for this epic, I want to update the Svelte interface to match the approved design mockup design/approved/20261117071024-mockup/mockup.html, so that users experience a polished, responsive knowledge base interface with complete visual fidelity.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the approved mockup at design/approved/20261117071024-mockup/mockup.html,
When the frontend components in frontend/src/ are rendered in desktop and mobile viewports down to 375px,
Then layout elements, color scheme, spacing, and typography match the approved design without horizontal scrolling or visual regressions.
Given an active user searching or filtering catalog records,
When interacting with search inputs, category facets, and document list elements,
Then all interactive states provide clear visible focus and active feedback with contrast ratio meeting WCAG AAA requirements.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: visual regression delta < 0.5% and 0 accessibility contrast violations
